Support

fourtillfour Check-In member app

For help with login, check-in, or your loyalty points, contact the shop or email us.

Contact

Email: support@fourtillfour.com

Please include the phone number on your loyalty account and a short description of the issue.

Common topics

  • Can’t sign in: Use the exact name and phone number on your fourtillfour loyalty contact. US numbers default to +1.
  • QR won’t scan: Ask staff to try again with good lighting, or use a hardware scanner if available.
  • Points: Points update after a successful staff scan and sync to GoHighLevel.
